title: App Surface Release and Readiness Realisation
authorityNotice: This artefact converts app-surface release, deployment, privacy, external-review, and owner-acceptance scope decisions into explicit scope decisions. It does not claim that external release evidence, deployment evidence, legal review, privacy compliance, store approval, or production proof exists.

realisedDecisions.decision: App Store provisioning is out of scope for the bounded local implementation phase. Apple account, signing, privacy label, privacy manifest, app review, TestFlight, and submission work require a fresh release evidence gate after a mobile implementation exists.
realisedDecisions.closureMeaning: The current gate closes as not applicable to bounded local implementation, not as App Store readiness.

realisedDecisions.decision: Google Play provisioning is out of scope for the bounded local implementation phase. Google Play account, signing, Data Safety, permission disclosure, Play Integrity, track setup, and submission work require a fresh release evidence gate after a mobile implementation exists.
realisedDecisions.closureMeaning: The current gate closes as not applicable to bounded local implementation, not as Google Play readiness.

realisedDecisions.decision: CDN deployment is out of scope for the bounded local implementation phase. Next.js provider evaluation remains policy-complete, but concrete provider credentials, DNS, TLS, deployment, rollback, logging, and live proof require a fresh deployment evidence gate after a web implementation exists.
realisedDecisions.closureMeaning: The current gate closes as not applicable to bounded local implementation, not as CDN deployment readiness.

realisedDecisions.decision: Privacy compliance readiness is out of scope for bounded local implementation. Data inventory, consent evidence, store disclosure evidence, retention/deletion/export proof, external review, and legal/compliance acceptance require a fresh privacy evidence gate before any compliance claim.
realisedDecisions.closureMeaning: The current gate closes as no compliance claim permitted, not as privacy compliance readiness.

realisedDecisions.decision: External review is not required before bounded local implementation that makes no store, deployment, privacy compliance, legal compliance, accessibility compliance, monetisation, live-provider, or production readiness claim. External review is mandatory before those claims or external release actions.
realisedDecisions.closureMeaning: The current gate closes for bounded local implementation only, not as external review completion.

realisedDecisions.decision: Owner acceptance is granted for bounded local implementation under the non-claims and prohibited external actions in this artefact. Owner acceptance is not granted for store, CDN, privacy compliance, external review completion, staging, live-provider, or production readiness.
realisedDecisions.closureMeaning: The owner acceptance gate closes for bounded local implementation only.

realisedDecisions.decision: The modern app-surface implementation gate parent closes because its local implementation children are closed and its release/deployment/compliance/review children are explicitly realised as out of scope for bounded local implementation. Fresh evidence gates are required before external release or readiness claims.
realisedDecisions.closureMeaning: The parent closes for bounded local implementation only.
